AUSTRALIAN REDUNDANCY PAY CALCULATOR · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

What redundancy pay, notice and leave are owed on this termination?

Enter pay, dates, age and employer size. You get the National Employment Standards redundancy weeks, the minimum notice period, the unworked notice payout and accrued annual leave, plus a plain statement of why no redundancy pay is due when the small business or casual exclusions apply.

Written from the published rules without a live lookup. Rules and awards change; the Fair Work Ombudsman decides. Not legal or employment advice.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: NES redundancy weeks by completed years of service, the small business (under 15 employees) and casual, fixed-term and apprentice exclusions, minimum notice including the age 45 extra week, unworked notice payout and accrued annual leave.
    • 
      
  • Gives: the amounts before tax and a text file you can keep with the termination record.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: long service leave, awards, enterprise agreements and contracts that pay more, leave loading, the tax treatment of the payment, unfair dismissal, whether the role is genuinely redundant, and employer applications to reduce the amount. Fair Work or an employment lawyer decides these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much redundancy pay am I entitled to in Australia?

    
Under the National Employment Standards it ranges from 4 weeks of base pay after 1 year of service up to 16 weeks at 9 years, then 12 weeks from 10 years. Check the Fair Work Ombudsman for the current table.

    
Do small businesses pay redundancy?

    
Not under the NES: an employer with fewer than 15 employees at the time of notice is exempt, though an award, enterprise agreement or contract may still require it.

    
Do casuals get redundancy pay?

    
No. Casual, fixed-term and task employees, apprentices and trainees are excluded from NES redundancy pay.

    
How much notice must be given?

    
1 to 4 weeks depending on years of service, plus 1 extra week for employees aged 45 or over with at least 2 years. Unworked notice is paid out.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.

  

  

    
No warranty. This tool is provided free and as-is, without warranty of any kind, express or implied. It is not legal or employment advice. You are responsible for verifying its output with the Fair Work Ombudsman before you pay an employee or sign a termination agreement.

    
Your answers. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
